description: Check an EIP-712 signature request BEFORE signing (the JSON passed to eth_signTypedData_v4): detects ERC-2612 Permit, DAI permit, Uniswap Permit2 (allowance + transfer) and Seaport orders, explains in one line what the signature grants, and flags drainer patterns: unlimited allowances, spender that is a plain wallet (EOA, checked on Base), zero-payment NFT listings, bulk listings, never-expiring grants. Returns risk (low/medium/high), grants, warnings and the EIP-712 digest. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base per call (x402).
name: evm_typed_data_check
